questions.text: Describe a pleasant surprise you had.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a pleasant surprise you had. You should say: what the surprise was; when it happened; who was involved; and explain why it was a pleasant surprise.

questions.text: Do you like planning surprises for other people?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you like planning surprises for other people?

questions.text: Why do people like giving surprises to their friends and family?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a pleasant surprise you had, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all surprises. Why do people like giving surprises to their friends and family?

questions.text: Do adults enjoy surprises as much as children do?

questions.text: Are there some people who don't like surprises? Why?
